sections.title: Prospectus Summary
text: The following summary is qualified in its entirety by, and should be read in conjunction with, the more detailed information and financial statements included herein.

In addition to this summary, we urge you to read the entire prospectus carefully, especially the risks of investing in our ordinary shares discussed under “Risk Factors” before deciding whether to buy our ordinary shares.

Currently, we have one wholly owned subsidiary, Deerhorse One Zero Eight Holding Limited, a Hong Kong limited company, referred to herein as, “Deerhorse HK”. Presently, Deerhorse HK does not have any material operations.

We intend to primarily operate through our Hong Kong subsidiary. While such plans have not yet materialized and while we currently have no formal agreements in place, through our wholly owned subsidiary, Deerhorse HK, we seek to acquire or enter into an undetermined business combination, with Jiangxi Luma 108 Information Technology Group Co., Ltd. referred to herein as, “Luma 108”.

Luma 108 is a Chinese Company established in the People’s Republic of China (or the “PRC”). Its core business revolves around serving as a central hub or online platform connecting individuals who provide charging solutions at their locations for electric scooters, bicycles, and similar modes of transportation. Upon accessing these charging stations, customers can conveniently buy goods from these hosts, who offer the charging facilities, all made possible through Luma 108's developed platform.
Luma 108 shares common management with the Company’s and directors, Huibin Jiang and Xiang Liu.
On September 20, 2023, DeerHorse One Zero Eight Group Holding Limited was incorporated under the laws of the Cayman Islands as an exempted company with limited liability.
On September 20, 2023, Mr. Huibin Jiang and Mr. Xiang Liu were both appointed as Directors to the Company.

text: An investment in our ordinary shares involves a high degree of risk. Before deciding whether to invest in our ordinary shares, you should consider carefully the risks described below, together with all of the other information set forth in this prospectus, including the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” and our consolidated financial statements and related notes. If any of these risks actually occurs, our business, financial condition, results of operations or cash flow could be materially and adversely affected, which could cause the trading price of our ordinary shares to decline, resulting in a loss of all or part of your investment. The risks described below and in the documents referenced above are not the only ones that we face. Additional risks not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also affect our business. You should only consider investing in our ordinary shares if you can bear the risk of loss of your entire investment.

sections.title: Dividend Policy
text: We have never declared or paid any cash dividends on our ordinary shares, and we do not currently intend to pay any cash dividends on our ordinary shares of stock in the foreseeable future.
We currently intend to retain all available funds and any future earnings to support operations and to finance the growth and development of our business.

Any future determination to pay dividends will be made at the discretion of our board of directors, subject to applicable laws, and will depend upon, among other factors, our results of operations, financial condition, contractual restrictions, and capital requirements.

From time to time, we may also enter into other loan or credit agreements or similar borrowing arrangements that may further restrict our ability to declare or pay dividends on our ordinary shares. Our board of directors will have sole discretion in making any future determination to pay dividends, subject to applicable laws, taking into account, among other factors, our results of operations, financial condition, contractual restrictions, and capital requirements.

sections.title: Business
text: Currently, Deerhorse One Zero Eight Group Holding Limited does not have any material operations. Through our wholly owned subsidiary, Deerhorse HK, we seek to acquire or enter into an undetermined business combination with Luma 108, which has common management with the Company. As such, below we have included our business plan for Luma 108, under the assumption that we may be successful with our efforts to enter into a business combination with Luma 108 or acquire some or all of Luma 108.

Luma 108 is a community retail online shopping platform and charging station operator. The business focuses on providing charging services for two-wheel electric vehicles and affordable sales of fast-moving consumer goods to community residents, aiming to build customer loyalty and achieve double-directional customer diversion.
Luma 108 operates through two core services: Charging Station Operations and E-commerce Platform Services, both designed to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.

In Charging Station Operations, a monthly membership plan is implemented to encourage customer retention, providing a consistent and predictable revenue stream. Charging subsidies are extended to members, aiming to ensure the stability and reliability of the customer base, fostering a sense of value and loyalty. To optimize overall service delivery, Luma 108 has established a comprehensive set of service management systems, encompassing supply chain management, logistics, warehousing, and after-sales support. This integrated approach contributes to a seamless and efficient experience for users utilizing the charging services.

Luma 108 offers secure and convenient two-wheeled electric charging services to community residents, concurrently developing a group leader model within the community to facilitate the swift expansion of e-commerce:

Unless otherwise stated, the rate of VAT shall be 17%.

Pursuant to the Notice on Value-Added Tax Policies of Software Products a general taxpayer who sells self-developed software products and subject to VAT at a rate of over 3% may, after being taxed at the fixed tax rate of 17%, receive a VAT refund.

According to the Circular of the SAT, on Adjusting Value-added Tax Rates, where a taxpayer engages in a taxable sales activity for the value-added tax purpose or imports goods, the previous applicable 17% and 11% tax rates are lowered to 16% and 10% respectively.

According to the Circular on Policies to Deepen Value-added Tax Reform, where a taxpayer engages in a taxable sales activity for the value-added tax purpose or imports goods, the previous applicable 16% and 10% tax rates are lowered to 13% and 9% respectively.

sections.title: Management
text: The following table sets forth information regarding our directors as of the date of this prospectus.

Huibin Jiang serves as the founder and chairman of LUMA 108, a prominent online service-commerce company. Additionally, he holds the position of brand ambassador at the 9th China Role Model Congress and serves as the Deputy Secretary of the "Be with you all the way" Party branch in Jiangxi Province, China. Drawing upon his extensive professional knowledge and practical experience, Jiang leads the LUMA 108 team in establishing the company as a key player in the online service e-commerce sector in China. Under his guidance, the company has earned widespread recognition within the industry, achieving notable success, and fostering innovation. Prior to his current role, Mr. Jiang held the position of CEO at Jiangxi Duosiying Information Technology Co., Ltd. from 2015 to 2021.

Xiang Liu is a graduate of Guangzhou First Military Medical University of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, holding a master's degree. From 2017 to 2021, Xiang Liu served as the CEO at Yinchongzhe New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. Currently, he holds the position of director at LUMA 108 and is recognized as an expert in the new energy industry. Xiang Liu possesses substantial knowledge and experience in the field of new energy.

Between 2012 and 2015, he actively participated in various new energy projects, applying innovative technologies to sectors such as agriculture, small towns, and special areas. His efforts yielded commendable results, earning widespread acclaim. In 2019, Xiang Liu assumed senior management roles in several new energy enterprises, demonstrating profound industry expertise and a robust network of human resources.

Recognizing the significant potential of the new energy vehicle market, Xiang Liu is a proponent of the notion that the development of new energy vehicles requires well-established supporting services, particularly in the domain of charging piles.

sections.title: Shares Eligible for Future Sale
text: Upon completion of this offering, we will have Ordinary Shares outstanding assuming the underwriters do not exercise their over-allotment option to purchase additional Ordinary Shares. Of that amount, Ordinary Shares will be publicly held by investors participating in this offering, and Ordinary Shares will be held by our existing shareholders, some of whom may be our “affiliates” as that term is defined in Rule 144 under the Securities Act. As defined in Rule 144, an “affiliate” of an issuer is a person that directly, or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, controls, or is controlled by, or is under common control with, the issuer. Prior to this offering, there has been no public market for our Ordinary Shares. While we intend to list the Ordinary Shares on the Nasdaq Capital market, we cannot assure you that a regular trading market will develop in our Ordinary Shares.

Future sales of substantial amounts of our Ordinary Shares in the public markets after this offering, or the perception that such sales may occur, could adversely affect market prices prevailing from time to time. As described below, only a limited number of our Ordinary Shares currently outstanding will be available for sale immediately after this offering due to contractual and legal restrictions on resale. Nevertheless, after these restrictions lapse, future sales of substantial amounts of our ordinary share, including ordinary share issued upon exercise of outstanding options, in the public market in the United States, or the possibility of such sales, could negatively affect the market price in the United States of our ordinary share and our ability to raise equity capital in the future.

sections.title: Taxation
text: The following summary of material Cayman Islands, PRC, and United States federal income tax consequences of an investment in our Ordinary Shares is based upon laws and relevant interpretations thereof in effect as of the date of this prospectus, all of which are subject to change. This summary does not deal with all possible tax consequences relating to an investment in our Ordinary Shares, such as the tax consequences under state, local and other tax laws.

The Cayman Islands currently levies no taxes on individuals or corporations based upon profits, income, gains or appreciation and there is no taxation in the nature of inheritance tax or estate duty. There are no other taxes likely to be material to us levied by the government of the Cayman Islands except for stamp duties which may be applicable on instruments executed in, or, after execution, brought within the jurisdiction of the Cayman Islands. The Cayman Islands is not party to any double tax treaties that are applicable to any payments made to or by our company. There are no exchange control regulations or currency restrictions in the Cayman Islands.

Payments of dividends and capital in respect of our ordinary shares will not be subject to taxation in the Cayman Islands and no withholding will be required on the payment of a dividend or capital to any holder of our ordinary shares, nor will gains derived from the disposal of our ordinary shares be subject to Cayman Islands income or corporation tax.

In March 2007, the National People’s Congress of China enacted the Enterprise Income Tax Law, which became effective on January 1, 2008 and was amended on February 24, 2017. The Enterprise Income Tax Law provides that enterprises organized under the laws of jurisdictions outside China with their “de facto management bodies” located within China may be considered PRC resident enterprises and therefore subject to PRC enterprise income tax at the rate of 25% on their worldwide income. …
